headline.caveat: Program-level target: Google + TPG Rise Climate partnership to co-develop co-located clean power + data-center parks, ~$20B of investment by 2030 incl. TPG capital and project debt. Google's own dollar commitment is undisclosed.

realized_to_date.caveat: Intersect closed a >$800M equity round (TPG-led, Google participating) at signing; deployed project capital since then is not broken out.

nature_md: Strategic partnership (Dec 2024) among Google, Intersect Power, and TPG Rise Climate to build 'energy parks' — new clean generation plus storage co-located with data-center campuses, so new load arrives with new power. Targets ~$20B of investment by 2030; first co-located capacity was targeted for 2026 with full operation in 2027. Google anchors as offtaker/tenant and equity participant (undisclosed amount within Intersect's >$800M round); TPG Rise Climate leads the capital. Structured as project-level JVs rather than a single fund.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Alphabet's equity participation is a balance-sheet investment (non-marketable equity); power offtake and leases from the parks will be opex/lease liabilities as projects reach COD. The $20B headline is mostly third-party capital, not an Alphabet commitment.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Intersect books equity proceeds as financing, then project revenue from each park's COD — data-center tenancy plus power sales. TPG capital sits at fund/project level.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** the structural fix for the interconnection-queue bottleneck — build generation and load together, additionality by design. **Bear:** the $20B is a program headline blending three parties' hypothetical capital; realized deployment through 2026 is a small fraction, and 'energy park' economics remain unproven at scale.
